rule: score0-score1-4; opposite for player1; bonuses included
selection: minimum fresh validation per-game MAE among gen0 and gen1 epochs, separately per seed; final seed chosen by validation only
split: all games with a prefix and seat pair stay together; conflicts with earlier split cause entire later group exclusion from prediction training/testing; final comparison conditions never train
bootstrap: old train only; old validation used for gen0; old test seen previously and never presented as unknown
randomization: 8 uniformly random legal placements, then deterministic top policy candidates; standard games have no opening randomization
stop: fixed 1 update, 188 games, 8 epochs/stage/seed, nonfinite or compute cap; no test-driven tuning
improvement: report paired MAE vs ridge and gen0 separately from WDL/margin vs ridge and gen4; no strength claim from MAE alone
